import ctypes
import math

def coerce_double(x):
    # Load libraries in correct order
    cblas = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
    gsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")
    
    # Define function prototype
    gsl.gsl_coerce_double.argtypes = [ctypes.c_double]
    gsl.gsl_coerce_double.restype = ctypes.c_double
    
    # Call the C function
    result = gsl.gsl_coerce_double(ctypes.c_double(x))
    return result

def assert_test():
    # Test with regular floating point numbers
    assert coerce_double(3.14) == 3.14
    assert coerce_double(-2.5) == -2.5
    assert coerce_double(0.0) == 0.0
    
    # Test with integer inputs (should be converted to float)
    assert coerce_double(42) == 42.0
    assert coerce_double(-7) == -7.0
    
    # Test with special floating point values
    assert math.isnan(coerce_double(float('nan')))
    assert math.isinf(coerce_double(float('inf')))
    assert math.isinf(coerce_double(float('-inf')))
    
    # Test with very large and very small numbers
    assert coerce_double(1e308) == 1e308
    assert coerce_double(1e-308) == 1e-308
    
    print("All tests passed!")
